name: Neolithic Flint Mines at Spiennes (Mons)
description: Beneath farmland near the village of Spiennes, just southeast of Mons in Belgium, lies Europe's earliest and largest cluster of ancient mines, spread over more than 100 hectares. From about 4300 to 2200 BC, Neolithic miners dug for flint here, trying out a variety of extraction methods. A settlement from the same era stood alongside the workings, so the miners' homes and workplace can be seen together.
